notes.title: Controller Support and More!
notes.notes: [h1]City of Cats Update 0.0.2.021 - Controller Support & Quality of Life Improvements[/h1][p]That time has come where there's another update based on your feedback and the roadmap. Here's what's new:[/p][h2]Controller Support[/h2][p]Complete gamepad compatibility is now live. Yes, this does mean that nearly all of City of Cats [b]now[/b] [b]works on Steamdeck[/b]. However, lower your settings to medium or low. This is something I'm looking into.  Controller support has been requested but it does also just feel right so here's the new feature list:[/p][list][*][p]Full controller support[/p][/*][*][p]Customisable keybinds - reassign any action to any button[/p][/*][*][p]Seamless switching between keyboard and controller anytime you like[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamic button prompts that update based on your current input method[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484482/868a6f478f9693e5a3e6b2300e75775665a46acc.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484482/50cede73bbfdb3d7b465cda3baf3334d771f6838.gif"][/img][/p][p]Note: one of the camera modes is not very fun with a controller but I'd rather leave the choice in for everyone just in case. [/p][p][/p][h2]Display & Audio Options[/h2][p]Proper settings menus are finally here:[/p][list][*][p]Multiple resolution options[/p][/*][*][p]Separate volume controls for music, SFX, and ambient audio[/p][/*][*][p]Windowed, fullscreen, and borderless window modes[/p][/*][*][p]Consistent styling throughout the settings menu[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484482/b97d6ce6a490864fdfd7bb44fa30d2dd8b242482.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Journal Improvements[/h2][p]Cat levelling is now much more transparent. Your journal displays exactly how stats will change when levelling up, giving you an idea of what's to come from following your instincts. I've also added a small door indicator to show when you have access to houses. You can see below the current level has no house access but the next one allows the cat in houses[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484482/d8fdfc8e75c6d23d0e5d4188324e7dc9e8a235a7.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Final Notes[/h2][p]I'm continuing to work through the roadmap and will have more updates soon as well as new additions in the roadmap found here -> [url="https://trello.com/b/ZDVRzvJA/city-of-cats-roadmap" style="button"]Roadmap[/url] [/p][p][/p][h2]Full Changelog[/h2][list][*][p]New Features[/p][list][*][p]Controller Support with full keybind support [/p][/*][*][p]Live control scheme swapping[/p][/*][*][p]Resolution and audio settings (finally!)[/p][/*][*][p]Added a way to see how your cat stats will change when levelling up (journal)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]General Fixes/Improvements[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that would cause the instinct to "sit under a bush" to be impossible to complete[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the weather to change very quickly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with anims/actions not stopping movement[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that cause the settings menu not to open[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up settings UI to match the rest of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Improved stability with settings[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that caused eating sounds to be played indefinitely under specific circumstances[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where it became impossible to become a pet even if you had a collar[/p][/*][*][p]Added House Access Identifiers to the journal screen so you can quickly see if you have access to houses and if your next level has house access[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some colliders for the doors colliding with the player camera[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused the camera mode to sometimes not be applied when it was changed[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.notes:
- Fixed an issue with the tutorial UI affecting the ability to stop eating if the cat is interrupted 
- Fixed an issue where pressing "unstuck" when in the tutorial would put the cat outside of the tutorial area
- Fixed some logic issues with general interaction
- Added the ability for the "unstuck" feature to reset some states of the cat just in case one gets stuck

notes.title: Tutorial and more!
notes.notes:
[p]The time has come, City of Cats has a tutorial! 

This has taken longer than I expected however I was able to extend a few systems that already existed that will give the game more flexibility in later updates.

The tutorial's content will be extended as City of Cats evolves so keep a look out for tutorial updates.

I've tried to keep it as straight forward and helpful as possible outlining the actions that need to be taken as well as the related keybindings. If you spot something that could be improved then let me know! 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484482/a914b2c954fade59e9fa5784ce385e07642716e4.gif"][/img]


Happy catting![/p][p][/p][p]- Owen[/p][p]

[b]Full Changelog:[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b]- New Features[/p][p]	- Full Offline Tutorial[/p][p]	- 2 new achievements [b]
[/b]
- General Fixes/Improvements[/p][p]	- Decreased firefly appearance frequency[/p][p]	- Pick up / drop animations added[/p][p]	- Adjusted size of the HUD bars seen in the stats menu to be closer to what looks correct[/p][p]	- Removed unused stat[/p][p]	- UI Sound effects (Part of a larger UI update)[/p][p]	- Improved precalc jump to allow for jumps that the were previously impossible [/p][p]	- Reworked instinct system to allow for more creative instincts and tutorial only instincts[/p]

notes.title: Eating and Drinking Hotfix
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where there the cat was unable to eat, drink, or open doors to houses even after becoming a level 2 pet

notes.title: You can now "unstuck" your cat!
notes.notes:
I've added a new option in the pause menu to allow people to free trapped cats and return them to the closest safe location.

To use it just go to the pause menu and click "Unstuck", it's as easy as that!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484482/dbf9fb66d1b17529278dfd2fee803b55dd15f37c.gif[/img]

I've also dropped in a few fixes that were missed out on the cat recode relating to achievements and some instincts being triggered correctly

Happy catting!

- Owen

notes.title: Hotfix for jump stability
notes.notes: - Updated anim notifies to improve precalc jump stability

notes.title: Cat rework plus some extras!
notes.notes:
This update is a pretty big one, it's taken some time to get everything in there but I feel it's worth the wait.

[h1]Cat Rework[/h1]
[h2]Jump Anywhere[/h2]
After a few requests we noticed a trend and it was one that made sense so here it is! The ability to jump wherever and whenever you want. The precalculated jump will take over if you're close to objects to keep your cat abilities flexible and precise but otherwise hop away!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484482/739773615739f86b2f4c782847ea0c30aba32c60.gif[/img]

[h2]Precalculated Jump[/h2]
The precalculated jump was... terrible... so its been stripped out and completely redone, now it's not an eyesore while you play! Below you can see a comparison of the new and old system. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484482/c795bb6f2506e9257f1913d97807008283825b3b.gif[/img]
[i]sorry for the flash in the gif on the right... that is the actual jump causing the flash, not the screen capture.. [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484482/ad823f5efb489da0b7ec86a2df5552598db32bd8.gif[/img]

[h2]General Movement[/h2]
When running around, the cat didn't really feel like it had any weight at any point so there's been a full rework of acceleration and momentum giving a weightier feeling to the cat
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484482/d4287c5d9dbda9b26391978b0b5c6b23103f3eea.gif[/img]

There's been a significant change to how the cat functions in the world in a more ways that I can list here so if something goes wrong just reach out!

[h1]Custom Keybinds[/h1]
They're here!
Now you can assign just about any key you like; there is a reset button just in case you don't like what you set.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484482/72f636ba998e2edf83d3d4c74b17f90ffca224fe.gif[/img]


There's a whole host of little QoL fixes in this update to do with UI and how it works, if you want to know more then the full changelog is below.

[h1]Full Changelog[/h1]
[b]New Features[/b]
	- Completely new jump system
		- Jump any time you want by pressing space with no object in front of you
		- Precalculated jump by getting an object in front of you first
	- Added Player assignable Keybindings
	- Ambient effects on a night
	
[b]Performance Fixes[/b]
	- Cat recode for netcode and mechanics (more tweaks to come)
	- Huge bandwidth reduction for general gameplay
	- Overall client stability improvements

[b]General Fixes[/b]
	- Fixed issue with the menu not being removed by the bound keys after interaction (ESC or P)
	- Fixed the settings menu and pause menu not closing if the player presses the keybind for the menus to close
	- Fixed chat message overflowing bubbles if a user has a longer username
	- Fixed some bushes not triggering cover for the cat
	- Fixed chat overflow issues with long usernames
	- Fixed HUD spacing issues for long usernames
	- Fixed cats being able to Purr while recovering from having no health
	- Fixed desync issues related to cleaning animations
	- Fixed links in game opening platform browser and instead switched to Steam Overlay unless it fails for any reason (optional QR code if the platform browser solution fails too)
	- Tweaked acceleration rates to feel more correct while moving at speed
	- Tweaked timings for the cat getting wet in the rain and then drying out after
